title: RepoCoder: Repository-Level Code Completion Through Iterative Retrieval and Generation

key_numbers.metric: Pass Rate, function body (GPT-3.5-Turbo, all repos)

key_numbers.value: K=10 max snippets; window Sw=20/50, Ss=10

stop_detail: Iteratively retrieves up to K=10 sliding-window code snippets via sparse Jaccard similarity, using the model's own draft prediction to refine the next round's retrieval query, then concatenates retrieved snippets with local context into the prompt (Sec 2.1-2.3).

title: A Review of Repository Level Prompting for LLMs

key_numbers.value: 68.51% (RLPG-H) vs 58.73% Codex baseline; oracle upper bound 79.63%

stop_detail: Sec. 2 'Repository Level Retrieval Techniques': RLPG selects among rule-based context proposers (parent/child/sibling/import/similar-name files) via a learned classifier (RLPG-H/R), while RepoCoder iteratively retrieves BM25-similar snippets using the model's own prior generation as the next query.

title: Dataflow-Guided Retrieval Augmentation for Repository-Level Code Completion
stop_detail: Parses the repository into a typed dataflow graph (entities linked by assigns/refers/typeof/inherits relations), then given unfinished code, extracts its imports and retrieves connected entities via depth-first search, restoring them to source text concatenated into the prompt (Sec 3.2-3.4).

title: Long Code Arena: a Set of Benchmarks for Long-Context Code Models

key_numbers.value: CodeLlama-7B: +16% infile lines, +53% inproject lines vs no-context

stop_detail: Sec. 3-4: each of six tasks defines its own project-wide context mechanism, e.g. BM25-retrieved top-20 relevant class/method names for library-based generation, files closest in the file tree to the target for project completion, and TF-IDF/CodeBERT/GTE/Mistral embedding retrieval plus BM25 for bug localization.

title: ContextModule: Improving Code Completion via Repository-level Contextual Information

key_numbers.metric: Soft Exact Match, CKG symbol definition (struct init)

stop_detail: Combines three retrieval channels at completion time-recently-browsed-file snippets ranked by cursor-click interaction, Jaccard-similarity code snippets from an inverted index, and symbol/struct definitions from a proprietary Code Knowledge Graph built via incremental static analysis-concatenated into an up-to-8k-token prompt (Sec III-A/B/C).

title: Prometheus: Towards Long-Horizon Codebase Navigation for Repository-Level Problem Solving

key_numbers.metric: Cost reduction / resolution gain from working memory

stop_detail: The Context Retrieval Engine synthesizes structured sub-queries, then performs multi-vector weighted retrieval against a persistent working memory of prior context units (falling back to knowledge-graph traversal on a memory miss), reusing exploration across reasoning steps (Sections 2.2, Abstract).

title: CodeRAG: Finding Relevant and Necessary Knowledge for Retrieval-Augmented Repository-Level Code Completion

key_numbers.metric: ReccEval EM, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B (100% data): CodeRAG vs DraCo
Ablation EM, StarCoder2-3B: full (df+s+d+lr) vs sparse-only
Avg per-query latency: CodeRAG vs RepoCoder vs DraCo

stop_detail: Repo files are parsed into an AST-derived knowledge base of functions/variables/class-functions (Sec 2.1); a log-probability-guided algorithm forms a query, then sparse (TF-IDF), dense (CodeT5p embeddings), and dataflow-dependency retrieval each contribute candidates, pruned by an LLM-based BestFit reranker (sliding-window heap sort) to top-u before concatenation into the completion prompt (Sec 2.2-2.4).

title: MHRC-Bench: A Multilingual Hardware Repository-Level Code Completion benchmark

key_numbers.metric: Fixed input context window across all evaluated models/methods

stop_detail: Cross-file repository context is built by concatenating whole files under '--- FILE: path (BEGIN) ---' delimiters up to a fixed 2,048-token window with head/tail truncation when over budget, optionally replaced by retrieval-augmented snippets from RepoCoder/GraphCoder/RLCoder baselines evaluated on the benchmark.

title: ContextBench: A Benchmark for Context Retrieval in Coding Agents

key_numbers.value: SWE-agent 0.544 vs mini-SWE-Agent 0.634 (File-level F1; 0.625 is SWE-agent's Block-level Recall)

stop_detail: Instruments agent trajectories during issue resolution to record every accessed file/line/block, then scores retrieved context against human-annotated gold contexts at file/block/line granularity for recall, precision, F1, redundancy, and usage-drop (Sec 2.5, 3.4).

title: RepoMirage: Probing Repository Context Reasoning in Code Agents with Perturbations
stop_detail: Three semantics-preserving perturbations (dependency-path indirection, runtime-target masking, local-value externalization) obscure direct repo cues, forcing broader agent exploration; RepoAnchor separates structure exploration from code construction via an intermediate INSTRUCTIONS.md artifact (Sec 3.1, 5.3)

title: SWE-Review: Closing the Loop on Issue Resolution with Agentic Code Review
stop_detail: Reviewer agent (OpenHands-SDK scaffold) agentically browses files, greps code, inspects dependencies, and executes reproducer commands in the repo to decide accept/request-changes and produce structured revision feedback in a generate-review-revise loop (Sec 3.1, Table 5)

title: Beyond "What to Retrieve": Uncertainty in Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
stop_detail: Uncertainty-aware framework retrieves API-knowledge, repository-context, and similar-code evidence via UniXcoder embeddings (up to 8 candidates each), scores it by combining token entropy, self-consistency, and semantic variance (weights 0.4/0.4/0.2) to filter/rank evidence before conditioning generation, verification, and repair (Problem Formulation, Eq. 1-9) [Adjudication: evidence filtering/ranking uses Eq. 6, distinct from the generation-uncertainty formula.]
